_status: DRAFT - Yenna writes the real content. Every text below is a short generic placeholder.
_how_to_read: For each region and status: summary (title of the 'What to do' card), self_care (checklist the astronaut can tick, saved for today), tell_crew and contact_surgeon (who to tell), prevention ('How to stay healthy'). status_keys maps the app status (green/yellow/orange/red) to the keys used here. The escalation ladder and its advice per environment stay in escalation.json.
